source.title: Ballymena Observer, 8 June 1967, p. 14 ("Ballymena Rural District Council: notice of result of elections")
source.publisher: Ballymena Observer (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Read from the Ballymena Observer's official notice of result, 8 June 1967, p. 14; the Galgorm figures were checked against the Belfast Telegraph's results table.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. The Galgorm division was the only contest; the other divisions were filled unopposed. The Longmore return, not legible in the Ballymena Observer's printing of the notice, is taken from the same notice in the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 8 June 1967, p. 14. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
